headline: iPad mini gets major upgrade but at a higher price, reviews say
summary: Reviews of the new iPad mini (A20 Pro) say Apple made significant improvements to the tablet this year, making it better than ever, but at a higher price that may deter some buyers.

claims.statement: Apple significantly improved the iPad mini this year, but at a higher price.

sources.quote: significant improvements to the iPad mini this year, but they don't come cheap
impressive new features make it a better tablet than ever—only to be betrayed by its higher price
